info.name: Microsoft Graph Get owners from servicePrincipals

params.name: $top
params.description: Show only the first n items

items.docs: Directory objects that are owners of this servicePrincipal. The owners are a set of nonadmin users or servicePrincipals who are allowed to modify this object. Supports $expand, $filter (/$count eq 0, /$count ne 0, /$count eq 1, /$count ne 1), and $select nested in $expand.

info.name: Microsoft Graph Remove service principal owner

items.docs: Remove an owner from a servicePrincipal object. As a recommended best practice, service principals should have at least two owners.
